sources.identifier: Intersalt Cooperative Research Group. BMJ 1988;297:319-328. DOI 10.1136/bmj.297.6644.319
sources.population: 10079 adults ages 20-59 from 52 centres in 32 countries, diverse community/workforce selection; antihypertensive use retained.
sources.measurement: Mean of two seated Hawksley random-zero readings after five-minute rest; measured weight and height twice; BMI kg/m^2. Original pp319-320.

sources.identifier: Zhang et al. J Clin Hypertens 2022;24:825-837. DOI 10.1111/jch.14529; PMC9278591
sources.population: BLSA 2009 Beijing community baseline, 1257 selected middle-aged/older adults; prior MI, stroke or severe CHF excluded and substantial blood refusal/missingness. Antihypertensive therapy retained. Age>=65 subgroup n=791; exact full age range not established.
sources.measurement: Mean of two seated Omron HEM-4021 readings within two minutes after five-minute rest on non-dominant arm; PP=SBP-DBP.

items.locator: Table II, p322, pooled BMI coefficient for SBP
items.selection: Within-centre adjusted regressions pooled by inverse variance; all 52 centres, source ages20-59.
items.applicability: Reported observational adjusted coefficient per1kg/m^2. Used unchanged as an assumed conditional BMI slope; transfer across adjustment, age range, country, era, weighting and treatment is unverified. Source SE is estimator precision, not residual spread or transport uncertainty.
